key_idea: Add up the lengths of the walls as Rose walks, until you reach 20 m.
steps: From B, Rose walks 6 m to D. She has walked 6 m.
Then 5 m up to C: 6 + 5 = 11 m.
Then 5 m down to E: 15 + 5 = 20 m. She stops at E.

choice_feedback.A: At A she has walked only 15 m.
choice_feedback.B: She would get back to B only after 27 m.
choice_feedback.C: At C she has walked only 11 m.
choice_feedback.D: At D she has walked only 6 m.
